{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the conversion rate by channel
# First, compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference_in_rates = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the results
print("Conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)
print(f"\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference_in_rates}")"}
